clue.text: Day round northern town

parts.note: Thurs is the short form of Thursday
a round letter, shaped like a ring

explanation.surface: A day trip around some town in the north of the country.
explanation.walkthrough: THURSO is a town on the far north coast of Scotland.
explanation.definitionFit: Thurso sits on the Caithness coast, the most northerly town on the British mainland.

clue.text: It is very good time to be an artist

parts.note: 'tis is the old contraction of it is
just so, said in approval, means very good
T is the abbreviation for time

explanation.surface: Someone says it is a great time to be an artist.
explanation.walkthrough: James Tissot was a French painter of Victorian society scenes, though most solvers know the name from the watch brand, which fits 'time'.
explanation.definitionFit: James Tissot was a nineteenth-century French painter and illustrator who worked in London.

clue.text: Like CID drug incident under investigation

parts.note: an upper is a stimulant drug
a case is a matter the police investigate

explanation.surface: The CID looks into a drugs case.
explanation.walkthrough: CID is the Criminal Investigation Department of British police; here it is just three capital letters.
explanation.definitionFit: The letters C, I and D are all capitals, so they are written in upper-case type.

clue.text: Where some were tried earlier, Hindu festivals set up

indicators.note: in a down clue, set up means raised so the word reads from bottom to top

parts.note: a mela is a Hindu fair or festival

explanation.surface: Historic trials and Hindu festivals being organised.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is cryptic: 'some' means alleged witches, tried in 1692.
explanation.definitionFit: Salem in Massachusetts held the notorious witch trials of 1692, so it is where people were put on trial long ago.

clue.text: Set off brilliant attempt to sell

parts.note: star as an adjective means outstanding
to tout is to try to sell goods, often pushily

explanation.surface: A brilliant salesman makes his opening pitch.
explanation.definitionFit: Both phrases describe beginning a journey or undertaking, a direct phrasal-verb synonym.

clue.text: Transforming into maltreated ragamuffin

indicators.note: transforming changes the form, so the letters are rebuilt in a new order

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: A neglected street urchin is changed into something better.
explanation.definitionFit: A tatterdemalion is a person in ragged, tattered clothing, an old word for a scruffy urchin.

clue.text: Substitute for engineers dispatched earlier?

parts.note: RE is the Royal Engineers
pre means before
sent is a synonym of dispatched

explanation.surface: Asking who replaces engineers who were sent off ahead of time.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Dispatched earlier' is read as a word for sent with a prefix meaning before stuck on the front; the question mark flags that playful reading.
explanation.definitionFit: To represent someone is to act or stand in for them, as an agent or delegate does.

clue.text: Very big vehicle shows character papa is after

parts.note: OS stands for outsize
a car is a vehicle

explanation.surface: An enormous vehicle displays a character with a dad chasing him.
explanation.definitionFit: In the NATO phonetic alphabet the code word for O comes directly before Papa, used for P.

clue.text: Lament mistreatment of thorny devil, not six left

indicators.note: mistreatment knocks things about, so the remaining letters are jumbled
not means the following items are taken away from the fodder

parts.note: taken as written; a thorny devil is an Australian lizard
the Roman numeral for six, to be removed
L is the abbreviation for left, to be removed

explanation.surface: Mourning the cruel treatment of a spiky lizard that has lost six of its kind.
explanation.definitionFit: A threnody is a song or poem of mourning, a formal word for a lament for the dead.

clue.text: Moon of Saturn in forbidden path making top news item

indicators.note: in places the moon's name inside the word for forbidden

parts.note: banned means prohibited
Rhea is the second-largest moon of Saturn
a line is a route or path

explanation.surface: A Saturnian moon straying onto a prohibited orbit becomes front-page news.
explanation.definitionFit: A banner headline runs across the full width of a front page, reserved for the biggest story.

clue.text: One enters to take the place of petitioner

indicators.note: something that enters goes inside, so the word for one sits within the other piece

parts.note: to supplant is to replace someone
the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: Someone steps in to replace a petitioner in a queue.
explanation.definitionFit: A suppliant humbly begs or asks for something, exactly what a petitioner does.

clue.text: Prince keeping superb racing horse

indicators.note: keeping means holding something inside, so one piece wraps the other

parts.note: Pr is the standard abbreviation for prince
ace as an adjective means excellent

explanation.surface: A royal owns a superb racehorse.
explanation.definitionFit: A pacer is a harness-racing horse that moves both legs on one side together.

clue.text: Row all but head of Trent tributary

indicators.note: all but the head means everything except the first letter is kept

parts.note: the Soar is an English river flowing into the Trent

explanation.surface: Rowing along a river feeding into the Trent.
explanation.walkthrough: The River Soar runs through Leicester into the Trent; dropping its S leaves OAR.
explanation.definitionFit: To oar is to propel a boat with blades, the verb sense matching row.

clue.text: European men confused with ringtone

indicators.note: confused letters are jumbled out of their usual order

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: A European bloke baffled by a phone's ringtone.
explanation.definitionFit: A Montenegrin is a native of Montenegro, a Balkan country on the Adriatic.

clue.text: Curve on road needs key traffic light

parts.note: C is a musical key
amber is the middle signal of a traffic light

explanation.surface: A bend in the road calls for a crucial set of traffic signals.
explanation.definitionFit: Camber is the slight convex arch or tilt of a road surface that helps drainage and cornering.

clue.text: Work as cleaner round West End, initially outfit on the Strand

indicators.note: round means going about the outside, so the cleaning phrase encloses the letters

parts.note: be a char: a char is a British cleaning lady

indicators.note: initially points to the opening letters of the two words before it

parts.note: the first letters of these two words

explanation.surface: A cleaner working around London's West End, wearing a smart outfit on the Strand.
explanation.walkthrough: The Strand is a famous West End street, but here strand means a shore; a char (charwoman) is a cleaner.
explanation.definitionFit: A strand is a beach, so clothing worn on the strand is beachwear.

clue.text: Reactionary — that is husband interrupting attorney, by the way

indicators.note: to interrupt is to break into the middle of something

parts.note: DA is a district attorney in the US
i.e. is the Latin abbreviation for that is
H is the abbreviation for husband
Rd is the abbreviation for road

explanation.surface: A conservative interrupts a lawyer, incidentally.
explanation.walkthrough: 'By the way' looks like an aside meaning incidentally, but it splits into a link word and an abbreviation for road.
explanation.definitionFit: A die-hard stubbornly resists change, just as a reactionary opposes progress.

clue.text: Praise a Democrat speech

parts.note: taken as written
D is the abbreviation for Democrat
an oration is a formal speech

explanation.surface: Lauding a Democrat's address.
explanation.definitionFit: Adoration is worship or deep admiration, praise in its most devoted form.

clue.text: Throw out fifty getting into small club

parts.note: S is the abbreviation for small

indicators.note: getting into means going inside the following pair of words

parts.note: a putter is a golf club
the Roman numeral for fifty

explanation.surface: Fifty members are expelled from a small club.
explanation.definitionFit: To splutter is to spit out words or sounds in a rapid, confused way, so to throw them out.

clue.text: Get ready to make cuts around theatre

indicators.note: around means surrounding, so one word encloses the other

parts.note: to pare is to trim or cut back
rep is short for repertory theatre

explanation.surface: A theatre prepares to make budget cuts.
explanation.definitionFit: To prepare is to make oneself or something ready, a straight verb synonym.

clue.text: Proposal that uses titanium in satellite

indicators.note: in places the element's symbol inside the other word

parts.note: a moon is a natural satellite
Ti is the chemical symbol for titanium

explanation.surface: A plan to build a satellite out of titanium.
explanation.definitionFit: A motion is a formal proposal put forward for debate at a meeting.

clue.text: Physicist's scheme united Celsius and Kelvin

parts.note: a plan is a scheme
C is the abbreviation for Celsius
K is the symbol for kelvin

explanation.surface: A scientist proposes combining two temperature scales.
explanation.definitionFit: Max Planck was the German physicist who founded quantum theory.

clue.text: Ed lunched with us, getting sozzled — not planned

indicators.note: sozzled means drunk, and drunk letters stagger out of order

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: An impromptu boozy lunch with a friend called Ed.
explanation.walkthrough: Sozzled is British slang for drunk.
explanation.definitionFit: Something unscheduled was never put on a timetable, so it happened without being arranged.

clue.text: Philosopher — one in short supply

indicators.note: in places the numeral inside the trimmed word
short means cut off at the end, so the last letter goes

parts.note: stock is a supply of goods
the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A philosopher is a rare commodity.
explanation.walkthrough: STOCK loses its K to give STOC, and I goes inside.
explanation.definitionFit: A Stoic is a follower of the Greek school of Zeno, a philosopher teaching endurance.

clue.text: Priest swindled outside game

indicators.note: outside means surrounding, so the swindling word goes around the game

parts.note: to do someone is to cheat them
RU is rugby union

explanation.surface: A clergyman cheated beyond the field of play.
explanation.definitionFit: A druid was a priest of the ancient Celtic religion in Britain and Gaul.

clue.text: Each article two pounds?

parts.note: a is the indefinite article
L is the symbol for a pound, twice over

explanation.surface: A shopper asks whether every item costs two pounds.
explanation.definitionFit: Used of a price, two pounds all means two pounds apiece, every single one counted.

clue.text: Figurative expression is right in excellent English

indicators.note: is ... in means the letter sits inside the following word

parts.note: top means first-rate
R is the abbreviation for right
E is the abbreviation for English

explanation.surface: A metaphor counts as correct in excellent English.
explanation.definitionFit: A trope is a figure of speech, a word used in a non-literal way.

clue.text: Old question over India in country of the Six Nations?

indicators.note: in puts the run of short pieces inside the country

parts.note: a country in the Middle East
O is the abbreviation for old
qu is the abbreviation for question
o is the cricket scorecard abbreviation for over
India is I in the NATO alphabet

explanation.surface: An old question about India among the nations in a rugby championship.
explanation.walkthrough: The Six Nations looks like the rugby tournament, but it is the Iroquois confederacy of North America.
explanation.definitionFit: The Iroquois League was a confederacy of six tribes, so Iroquoian describes things belonging to them.

clue.text: Note put in to request supply of another instrument

indicators.note: put in to means placed inside the following phrase

parts.note: to reorder is to order a fresh supply of something
C is a musical note

explanation.surface: A memo asking a supplier for one more instrument.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Another' belongs to the wordplay, though it seems to tell you the instrument is a second one.
explanation.definitionFit: The recorder is a woodwind instrument blown through a mouthpiece, often learnt at school.

clue.text: Drifting sand blocks Greek port

indicators.note: drifting things move about and do not stay in place
something that blocks sits in the middle of a passage, so it goes inside

parts.note: Gk is the abbreviation for Greek
the four letters rearranged

explanation.surface: Drifting sand clogs up a harbour in Greece.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface points to a Greek port, but the port is Polish.
explanation.definitionFit: Gdansk is a major Baltic seaport in northern Poland.
